源与目标容量、逻辑扇区大小必须一致。整个目标磁盘会保持脱机，避免副本中的重复标识: Source and target must match in capacity and logical sector size. The entire target disk stays offline to prevent auto-mounting duplicate identifiers.

完整备份包含空闲空间；开启压缩可减少占用。: Full backup includes free space. Compression can reduce storage use.
还原要求备份类型、容量及逻辑扇区与目标一致。: Restoring requires matching backup scope, capacity and logical sector size.
目标原有文件系统及数据将被替换，无法撤销。: The target's existing file system and data will be replaced permanently.

支持 NTFS（含常规 LZNT1 压缩与普通文件的命名数据流）、FAT12/1: Supports NTFS, including standard LZNT1 compression and named streams on regular files, plus FAT12/16/32 and exFAT. 续扫沿用保存时的模式与范围。保存进度后可关闭程序，下次加载继续。: Resuming uses the saved scan mode and range. You can close the app after saving and load that progress later.
从左侧选择真实磁盘。此处不会自动扫描；导入镜像的分区表查看仍在“磁盘管理”中。: Choose a physical disk from the left to start. Use Disk Management to view an imported image’s partition table.
预览只读取候选内容，不执行文件。显示正常也不能保证整个文件完整。: The preview reads candidate contents without executing the file. The full file may be damaged even if it previews correctly.
读取目录后可预览、选择文件，提取到其他磁盘。文件系统支持范围与“文件恢复”一致。: After reading the directories, preview and select files to extract to another disk. File system support matches File Recovery.

直接浏览目录并提取文件，无需还原整盘或挂载备份。: Browse directories and extract files directly from the backup, without restoring the entire disk or mounting the backup.
支持 DiskStudio .dsbackup 完整、压缩及增量备份。打开时校验: Supports full, compressed and incremental DiskStudio .dsbackup files. Contents are verified on open. For incremental backups, select the full dependency chain. Proprietary DiskGenius backups are unavailable.

ZIP / Office：最多 16384 个条目、8 MiB 目录、512 M: ZIP and Office limits are 16,384 entries, an 8 MiB directory and 512 MiB of decompressed data. Archive checks are capped at 64 GiB per scan. 支持 RAW/IMG、VHD/AVHD、VHDX、VDI、VMDK 和独立 Pa: Supported formats include RAW/IMG, VHD/AVHD, VHDX, VDI, VMDK and standalone Parallels files. You can select VHD parent disks and VMDK extents. Dirty VHDX logs, other differencing chains and snapshots in directory packages are unsupported.
文件系统支持 NTFS、FAT、exFAT，以及干净卸载的 Ext2/3/4 现: Supports NTFS, FAT, exFAT and existing files on cleanly unmounted Ext2/3/4. The source image is read-only and remains unmounted. Extract files to another disk and verify each file by SHA-256. Deleted candidates may be incomplete. For RAW partition images, select the correct scope and sector size.
所选文件以禁止共享写入的句柄保持打开，不挂载、不修改来源；父盘和分卷需要明确选择: Selected files stay open with shared writes blocked. The sources remain unmounted and unchanged. Select parent disks and extents explicitly. In-image paths are ignored. If a virtual disk is in use, shut down the virtual machine using it first.

独立 VirtualBox 镜像，全零块不分配，512 B 扇区。: Standalone VirtualBox image with 512 B sectors and no allocation for zero-filled blocks.
独立 VirtualBox 镜像，完整分配全部数据块，512 B 扇区。: Standalone VirtualBox image with 512 B sectors and all data blocks allocated.
独立 VHDX 镜像，全零块不分配，保留 512 B 或 4 KiB 扇区。: Standalone VHDX image that skips zero-filled blocks and keeps 512 B or 4 KiB sectors.

独立 monolithicSparse 镜像，含冗余映射表，512 B 扇区，最: Standalone monolithicSparse image with redundant grain tables and 512 B sectors, up to 2040 GiB.
独立 HDS 数据文件，512 B 扇区；不创建虚拟机目录包或快照描述文件。: Standalone HDS data file with 512 B sectors. Creates no VM package or snapshot descriptor.
请输入有效的正数容量，最多九位小数。: Enter a positive capacity with up to nine decimal places.
容量无法精确表示为整数个字节。: The capacity must be an exact whole number of bytes.
MBR 镜像创建限 512 B 扇区、最大 2 TiB；其他容量请选择 GPT。: MBR images use 512 B sectors and are limited to 2 TiB. For other capacities, choose GPT.
镜像容量须为 4 MiB–8 TiB，并按所选逻辑扇区对齐。: Image capacity must be 4 MiB–8 TiB and aligned to the selected logical sector size.
该目标格式仅支持 512 B 扇区，请为 4 KiB 源选择 RAW 或 VHD: This format requires 512 B sectors. For a 4 KiB source, choose RAW or VHDX.
VHD v1 不能超过 2040 GiB。: VHD v1 supports up to 2040 GiB.
单文件稀疏 VMDK 不能超过 2040 GiB。: Single-file sparse VMDK supports up to 2040 GiB.

已取消；partial 文件保留，未发布成功镜像。: Canceled. The partial file was retained. No completed image was saved.

显示本次读取时的记录；时间和属性可能滞后、被修改或已经失效。未知时区不按当前电脑: These records reflect the latest read. Times and attributes may be stale, modified, or invalid. Unknown time zones stay unspecified. The metadata change time is separate from the creation time.
这里只查看属性。复制时的保留选项和逐项结果以复制窗口及输出清单为准。: See the copy dialog for preservation options and the output manifest for per-file results.

请输入不同、按逻辑扇区对齐且位于磁盘内的起点。: Enter a different start location within the disk, aligned to the logical sector size.
断点文件保存在另一块物理磁盘上。请在移动前备份重要数据。: Save the checkpoint file on another physical disk. Back up important data before moving the partition.
在当前 Windows 用户下，选择此脱机磁盘对应的 .dsmove 断点。: Using the current Windows account, select the .dsmove checkpoint for this offline disk.
复核目标数据、卷引导区及 GPT，磁盘保持脱机。: Verify target data, volume boot sectors, and GPT. The disk stays offline.
新旧范围重叠，将按方向搬移并逐块回读。: The ranges overlap. Data moves in the required direction with readback for every block.
磁盘在移动期间及结束后保持脱机。中途停止时请保留断点，从磁盘菜单继续。: The disk stays offline during and after the move. If you stop partway through, keep the checkpoint and resume from the Disk menu.
校验已搬移和剩余源数据: Verify moved and remaining source data
搬移与逐块回读: Move and read back each block
已复核断点中的完整数据、卷引导区及主备 GPT。磁盘保持脱机。: Verified all checkpoint data, volume boot sectors, and both GPT copies. The disk stays offline.
分区已移动并核对完整数据、卷引导区及主备 GPT。磁盘保持脱机。: Partition moved. All data, volume boot sectors, and both GPT copies were verified. The disk stays offline.

移动确认无效或已过期。: The move confirmation is invalid or expired.
保存 MBR / EBR 或 GPT 主备分区表，用于保留当前分区布局。备份文件: Save the MBR/EBR or both GPT tables to preserve the current layout. Store the backup on another disk.
同时备份各分区的首扇区: Include the first sector of each partition
保存原始字节，不代表完整的文件系统或文件备份。: Saves raw bytes for the first sector only. Back up files or the full file system separately.

备份已保存并通过回读校验: Backup saved and verified by readback
备份前会核对磁盘身份并锁定同盘卷。分区表损坏、状态不完整或卷被占用时会停止；验证: Backup validates disk identity and locks volumes on that disk. It stops if the table is damaged, disk state is incomplete, or a volume is in use. Verification reads only the backup file.
仅检查显式读取的磁盘首尾各 1 MiB，以及 512 字节 MBR 链路指向的最: The check reads the first and last 1 MiB, plus up to 64 EBRs referenced by a 512-byte MBR. It covers partition tables only, without locking volumes or writing to disk. Run it again if the disk changes.
检查读取逻辑磁盘首尾各 1 MiB，以及 MBR 链路指向的最多 64 个 EB: The read-only check examines the first and last 1 MiB and up to 64 EBRs referenced by the MBR. For virtual disks it also checks container metadata and block mappings. It covers partition layout and container structure. Reopen the image if the source file changes.
正在读取并检查分区表…: Reading and checking the partition table…
正在复核修复来源和保护状态…: Checking the repair source and protection status…
正在锁定、修复并回读校验…: Locking volumes, repairing, and verifying by readback…
修复预览类型不匹配，请重新检查。: The repair preview type is incorrect. Run the check again.
检查 GPT 主备表的完整性与分区范围，或 512 字节 MBR 的主分区和扩展: Check both GPT copies and partition ranges, or primary partitions and the extended chain of a 512-byte MBR. Device reads start when you run the check.
保留完整 GPT 副本、保护性 MBR 和全部分区条目，不改变分区起点、容量、G: Preserves the intact GPT copy, protective MBR, and all partition entries, including their starts, sizes, GUIDs, names, and attributes.
确认后将锁定全部同盘卷并使整盘脱机。逐段写入并回读校验，成功或失败均保持脱机；不: After confirmation, all volumes on the disk are locked and the disk is taken offline. Each range is written and read back for verification. The disk stays offline after success or failure. There is no automatic retry or rollback. Confirm within 5 minutes.
保留 {bytes} B 的检查快照，重复读取确认内容未变。: Retained a {bytes} B snapshot. A second read confirmed the content was unchanged.
修复限非系统 GPT 磁盘，必须有一份完整有效且与 Windows 布局一致的表: Repair requires a non-system GPT disk with one intact table matching the Windows layout. Repair is unavailable for conflicting valid tables, two damaged tables, hybrid MBRs, and unknown storage structures.

容量来自 Btrfs 设备记录。原分区末端可能位于文件系统边界之后。: The size comes from the Btrfs device record. The original partition may end beyond the filesystem boundary.
